title: Are mangroves and lagoons safe? A global assessment of PAH pollution, sources, and ecological risks
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00753D, Critical Review
Liberty Chidewe
Coastal mangroves and lagoons frequently receive substantial inputs of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) from urban runoff, industrial emissions, and oil spills.
